name: sandworm-stocks
description: Runs every server of Sandworm Stocks together. Each app has its own package.json; this one only starts them.

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm --dir apps/web install && pnpm --dir apps/mcp install
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --build --wait && concurrently --names web,mcp,realtime --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow --kill-signal SIGTERM "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm --dir apps/mcp dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web realtime"
